annotations.title: Was this report issued, and what came before it

description: Whether ASPERN issued a due-diligence report, from the id printed on it (the full 64-hex digest, or the 12-character display id), and the revision chain of that vault: every issue in order with its time, the method and build it was made under, the issue it supersedes and the one that superseded it (each as a resolvable address), and why each revision exists (reasonCode: first_issue, correction, methodology_change, build_change, newer_readings, reissued). The proof of issue and nothing of the content: the report is sold per vault and is not kept behind a public address. Free.

digest.description: The full 64-hex digest from the report’s closing lines, or the 12-character document id printed on its pages.

name: report_issue

chain.description: Per vault: issues in order (previous, previousUrl, reasonCode, reason, methodologyChanged, buildChanged), dailySnapshots, latestPublished, reasonCodes.

issued.description: Each matching issue: reportId, slug, issuedAt, readAt, methodology, build, revision, supersedes, supersededBy, supersedesUrl, supersededByUrl, reasonCode, reason, revocation.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

reportId.description: The authoritative full id, null where a display id matched several.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
